svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Mid-Call Media Failover & Session State Recovery Architecture (Stage 369 · P731–P732)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of stateless call-drop failure vs SIP Re-INVITE / WebRTC ICE Restart mid-call media re-anchoring with turn-checkpoint hydration (P731) and hedged LLM/TTS provider circuit-breaker failover with voice persona lock (P732).
svg.text: STAGE 369 · ROUND 9 · P731–P732
Mid-Call Media Failover (SIP Re-INVITE / ICE Restart) & Checkpoint Recovery
通话中网关/模型故障不断线重锚定：SIP Re-INVITE / WebRTC ICE Restart + 对话纪元快照热恢复 (P731) 与多区域模型熔断对冲切换 (P732)
① P731: Mid-Call Media Re-Anchoring & Checkpoint Hydration
⛔ Legacy Stateless Worker Crash (2m into Call)
• Worker Pod OOM / Region A Drain -> RTP Socket Closes -> 10s Dead Air -> Call Drops
• Or Naive Reconnect Wipes In-Memory History -> Bot Asks "Who are you?" All Over Again
• Worse: Unfenced Retry Re-Executes Already-Committed Payment / Booking Tool Call!
Industry Baseline: >68% caller abandonment when forced to redial & re-authenticate (anonymized_reported)
✅ P731: Signaling Anchor Split + Re-INVITE / ICE Restart + Checkpoint Hydration
1. Decouple Signaling & Media: Edge SBC / TURN cluster holds carrier call leg alive
2. Per-Turn Delta Checkpoint: Commit {verifiedIdentity, turnEpoch, confirmedSlots,
committedIdempotencyKeys[], rollingSummary} to Redis/Cosmos after every turn
3. Fast Media Re-Anchor (<=1,500ms budget): Trigger SIP Re-INVITE (new SDP c=/m=)
or WebRTC ICE Restart (new ice-ufrag/ice-pwd) to Standby Media Worker in Region B
4. Idempotent Resume: Standby Worker loads checkpoint, skips committed tool keys,
and resumes exact dialogue step without re-asking caller identity
P731 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P732: Provider Circuit Breaker, Hedged Stream & Persona Continuity
Failover Tier Comparison (Architecture Target vs Cost)
• Tier 1: Stateless Drop & Redial — Only for non-critical FAQ lines; loses call & state
• Tier 2: SIP Re-INVITE / ICE Restart + Redis Checkpoint (P731 Recommended)
~800ms–1,500ms audio bridge pause, only +5% state overhead, preserves call & slots
• Tier 3: Dual-Region 1+1 RTP Shadowing — Only for 988/ER/Trading VIP lines
~50ms–150ms RTP switch, ~2.0x media compute cost
✅ P732: Brownout Detection (HTTP 429/503 or TTFA > 1,800ms)
• Pre-Cached Edge Comfort Audio: Play local edge PCM bridge ("请稍候，正在为您刷新连接...")
when primary LLM/S2S first-token latency exceeds 1,800ms threshold
• Secondary Region / Cascaded Fallback: Reroute turn to healthy secondary region
• Voice Persona & Locale Lock: Enforce matching timbre/gender/locale voiceId on backup
TTS so the agent never swaps from a female Mandarin voice to a male English voice mid-call
P732 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 369 · DIMENSION 372)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P731/P732): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Live Production Media/Signaling Failover: Carrier SIP Re-INVITE, WebRTC STUN/TURN ICE Restart, and Redis replication RTT are not_measured in local unit tests (engineering budget: 800ms–1,500ms).
